areas.narrativeSummary: Alverstoke Junior School emphasises SMSC (social, moral, spiritual and cultural) development alongside British Values [1]. Its vision is rooted in Christian values of Love, Courage and Respect, with an aim to nurture every child to be ambitious in learning, courageous in action and respectful to themselves, others and the world around them [2]. The curriculum also seeks to develop spiritual knowledge of different faiths and cultural understanding as preparation for life in modern Britain [3].
